definitions.gloss: airtight seal; hermetic seal; sealed shut
definitions.explanation: Sealing something completely so that no air, moisture, or contaminants can enter or escape. Used for food storage, packaging, and containers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{密封|みっぷう}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{保存|ほぞん}→保存：03626_hozon⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I store food by sealing it airtight.

examples.japanese: {密封|みっぷう}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{容器|ようき}→容器：03656_youki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please put it in a sealed container.

examples.japanese: {開封後|かいふうご}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{密封|みっぷう}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ}→冷蔵庫：01046_reizouko⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{保管|ほかん}して→保管する：25536_hokansuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: After opening, seal it airtight and store in the refrigerator.

notes:
USAGE:
Commonly seen on food packaging and product instructions. Also used in scientific and industrial contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {密封|みっぷう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to seal airtight)
- {密封|みっぷう}⟦{容器|ようき}→容器：03656_youki⟧ (sealed container; airtight container)
- {密封|みっぷう}⟦{保存|ほぞん}→保存：03626_hozon⟧ (airtight storage)
- {密封|みっぷう}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧ (sealed; hermetically sealed)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{封印|ふういん}→封印：12384_fuuin⟧: seal — broader meaning including figurative sealing (sealing away a memory, technique)
- ⟦{密閉|みっぺい}→密閉：19651_mippei⟧: airtight closure — very similar, but more commonly used for rooms or spaces
